initial.stage:
set -eu
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 MIX_ENV=prod
export MIX_HOME=/staging/app/.bedrock-tools/mix HEX_HOME=/staging/app/.bedrock-tools/hex
mkdir -p /staging/app
cd /staging/app
test ! -L .git
if test -d .git; then
  test "$(git remote get-url origin)" = 'https://github.com/Mojility/bedrock-system-template'
  test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
else
  git init -q
  printf '%s
' '.bedrock-tools/' >> .git/info/exclude
  git remote add origin 'https://github.com/Mojility/bedrock-system-template'
  git fetch --depth 1 origin '116969003b5c4d5c332d0169d3db613eab64af34'
  git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
fi
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '116969003b5c4d5c332d0169d3db613eab64af34'
test ! -e _build && test ! -L _build
test ! -e deps && test ! -L deps

mix local.hex --force
mix local.rebar --force
test -f mix.lock
MIX_ENV=dev mix deps.get --check-locked
MIX_ENV=dev mix deps.compile
MIX_ENV=dev mix compile --warnings-as-errors
MIX_ENV=test mix deps.get --check-locked
MIX_ENV=test mix deps.compile
MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors
mix deps.get --check-locked
git diff --exit-code -- mix.lock
mix deps.compile
mix compile --warnings-as-errors
mix assets.deploy
initial.compile:
set -eu
runtime_compile_started=$(date +%s)
MIX_HOME=/workspace/app/.bedrock-tools/mix HEX_HOME=/workspace/app/.bedrock-tools/hex MIX_ENV=prod mix compile --warnings-as-errors
printf 'bedrock_runtime_compile_seconds: %s\n' "$(( $(date +%s) - runtime_compile_started ))"
initial.service:
set -eu
umask 077
if test ! -f /workspace/runtime.env; then
  printf 'export SECRET_KEY_BASE=%s
' "$(openssl rand -hex 64)" > /workspace/runtime.env
fi
printf '%s
' 'export CUSTOMER_EXPLORATION=true' 'export EXPLORATION_PARENT_ORIGIN=https://qualification.mybedrock.ca' 'export EXPLORATION_PLATFORM_ORIGIN=https://mybedrock.ca' 'export EXPLORATION_MEDIA_ORIGIN=https://qualification-media.mybedrock.ca' >> /workspace/runtime.env
. /workspace/runtime.env
exec env MIX_HOME=/workspace/app/.bedrock-tools/mix HEX_HOME=/workspace/app/.bedrock-tools/hex MIX_ENV=prod PHX_SERVER=true PORT=4000 mix phx.server
initial.smoke:
set -eu
. /workspace/runtime.env
readiness_attempt=0
until curl --fail --silent --output /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4000/health/ready; do
  readiness_attempt=$((readiness_attempt + 1))
  if test "$readiness_attempt" -ge 30; then
    printf '%s
' 'application_readiness_timeout' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
exec env MIX_HOME=/workspace/app/.bedrock-tools/mix HEX_HOME=/workspace/app/.bedrock-tools/hex MIX_ENV=prod PHX_SERVER=false mix run --no-start scripts/smoke.exs

retained.stage:
set -eu
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 MIX_ENV=prod
export MIX_HOME=/staging/app/.bedrock-tools/mix HEX_HOME=/staging/app/.bedrock-tools/hex
mkdir -p /staging/app
cd /staging/app
test ! -L .git
if test -d .git; then
  test "$(git remote get-url origin)" = 'https://github.com/Mojility/bedrock-system-template'
  test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
else
  git init -q
  printf '%s
' '.bedrock-tools/' >> .git/info/exclude
  git remote add origin 'https://github.com/Mojility/bedrock-system-template'
  git fetch --depth 1 origin '116969003b5c4d5c332d0169d3db613eab64af34'
  git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
fi
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '116969003b5c4d5c332d0169d3db613eab64af34'
test ! -e _build && test ! -L _build
test ! -e deps && test ! -L deps
# Stable dependency preparation; application outputs never enter the cache.
test -d /preparation/cache
preparation_content_manifest() {
  find deps build -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum
  find deps build -type l -printf '%p -> %l\n' | LC_ALL=C sort
}
preparation_key=$({
  printf '%s\n' 'bedrock-dependencies-v1:490024a3-6c4a-5967-95e0-62719360ac89' 'dev,test,prod' 'warnings-as-errors'
  uname -sm
  cat /etc/os-release
  elixir --version
  printenv | LC_ALL=C sort | sed -n '/^ERL_/p; /^ELIXIR_/p; /^MIX_/p; /^CC=/p; /^CFLAGS=/p; /^LDFLAGS=/p'
  dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}=${Version}\n'
  git ls-files -z -- mix.exs mix.lock config assets package.json package-lock.json .tool-versions mise.toml '*.c' '*.h' '*.rs' Cargo.lock | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum
} | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
export BEDROCK_PREPARATION="/preparation/cache/490024a3-6c4a-5967-95e0-62719360ac89/$preparation_key"
if test -d "$BEDROCK_PREPARATION/build" && ! (cd "$BEDROCK_PREPARATION" && test -f content.sha256 && preparation_content_manifest | cmp -s content.sha256 -); then
  printf '%s\n' 'bedrock_preparation: corrupt_or_incomplete; rebuilding_in_fresh_namespace'
  export BEDROCK_PREPARATION="$BEDROCK_PREPARATION/recovery-$(date +%s)-$$"
fi
export HEX_HOME="$BEDROCK_PREPARATION/hex"
if test -d "$HEX_HOME"; then
  printf '%s\n' 'bedrock_preparation: compatible_namespace; application_artifacts=fresh'
else
  printf '%s\n' 'bedrock_preparation: cold_or_incompatible; application_artifacts=fresh'
fi
mkdir -p "$HEX_HOME"
# Hex validates package checksums against the selected lockfile on extraction.
printf 'bedrock_preparation_fingerprint: %s\n' "$preparation_key"
mix() {
  case "$1" in
    deps.get)
      MIX_DEPS_PATH="$BEDROCK_PREPARATION/deps" command mix "$@"
      ;;
    deps.compile)
      preparation_started=$(date +%s)
      MIX_DEPS_PATH="$BEDROCK_PREPARATION/deps" MIX_BUILD_PATH="$BEDROCK_PREPARATION/build/$MIX_ENV" command mix "$@"
      printf 'bedrock_preparation_dependency_seconds: %s %s\n' "$MIX_ENV" "$(( $(date +%s) - preparation_started ))"
      (cd "$BEDROCK_PREPARATION" && preparation_content_manifest > content.sha256)
      preparation_started=$(date +%s)
      # A Git dependency can contain read-only pack files. Replace the
      # previous environment's promoted copy before copying another one.
      rm -rf deps
      mkdir -p "_build/$MIX_ENV/lib" deps
      cp -aL "$BEDROCK_PREPARATION/deps/." deps/
      cp -aL "$BEDROCK_PREPARATION/build/$MIX_ENV/lib/." "_build/$MIX_ENV/lib/"
      printf 'bedrock_preparation_promotion_seconds: %s %s\n' "$MIX_ENV" "$(( $(date +%s) - preparation_started ))"
      ;;
    *) command mix "$@" ;;
  esac
}

mix local.hex --force
mix local.rebar --force
test -f mix.lock
MIX_ENV=dev mix deps.get --check-locked
MIX_ENV=dev mix deps.compile
MIX_ENV=dev mix compile --warnings-as-errors
MIX_ENV=test mix deps.get --check-locked
MIX_ENV=test mix deps.compile
MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors
mix deps.get --check-locked
git diff --exit-code -- mix.lock
mix deps.compile
mix compile --warnings-as-errors
mix assets.deploy
preparation_started=$(date +%s)
mkdir -p /staging/app/.bedrock-tools/hex
if test -e "$HEX_HOME/cache.ets"; then
  test -f "$HEX_HOME/cache.ets" && test ! -L "$HEX_HOME/cache.ets"
  cp -p "$HEX_HOME/cache.ets" /staging/app/.bedrock-tools/hex/cache.ets
fi
export HEX_HOME=/staging/app/.bedrock-tools/hex
printf 'bedrock_preparation_registry_promotion_seconds: %s\n' "$(( $(date +%s) - preparation_started ))"
